title: Full Stack Forward Deployed Developer
summary: Build and maintain high-performance web applications in Python, Django, React and PostgreSQL, and bring AI capabilities and autonomous agents into real workflows.
body:
## About the role

We are looking for a versatile full stack developer to design, build and maintain high-performance web applications using Python, Django, React and PostgreSQL. In addition to core web engineering, you will play a central role in integrating modern AI capabilities and autonomous AI agents into our workflows to drive intelligent automation. Experience with DevOps practices and deployments is a strong plus.

## Employment

This role is based in Ahmedabad, and you must live in or be willing to relocate to the city. You will join under the PUCAR mission to begin with. Your contract is expected to move later to an entity designated by the Gujarat High Court, so please apply only if you are comfortable with that transfer.

## Key responsibilities

- **Backend development:** architect, build and maintain robust RESTful APIs and backend services using Python and Django.
- **Frontend development:** design and implement responsive, intuitive UI components using React and contemporary JavaScript/TypeScript tools.
- **Database management:** model, optimise and manage relational databases using PostgreSQL; write efficient queries and manage migrations.
- **AI and agent integration:** design and deploy AI-driven features, leveraging LLM APIs, prompt engineering, structured outputs and autonomous AI agent frameworks to extend product functionality.
- **System architecture and quality:** ensure end-to-end system reliability, security, clean code practices and comprehensive test coverage.

## Requirements and qualifications

- 3 years of experience
- Strong proficiency in Python and the Django web framework
- Solid experience building modern web interfaces with React
- Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL schema design, complex queries and performance tuning
- Demonstrated experience building with AI, LLMs and AI agents (e.g. function calling, retrieval/RAG workflows, agentic automation)
- Familiarity with asynchronous tasks and queues (e.g. Celery, Redis) and REST API standards

## Nice to have

- **DevOps experience:** hands-on knowledge of Docker containerisation, CI/CD pipelines and cloud platform infrastructure (e.g. AWS, GCP or NIC Cloud)
- Experience with vector databases and semantic search implementations
- Understanding of security best practices, authentication protocols and API gateway configurations
